title: Real Estate Sales Executive
summary: A real estate sales executive sells homes in a developer's residential projects, taking buyers from first enquiry through site visit to booking. They sit in the project's sales team, working with pre-sales callers, channel partners (brokers), home loan banks and the post-booking customer team.
dailyDuties: Call back new enquiries and schedule site visits
Show buyers around the project and sample flat
Prepare cost sheets and explain payment plans
Complete booking forms and hand over to the agreement team
Help buyers apply for home loans with tie-up banks
Update every lead and visit in the CRM
Review weekly booking numbers with the sales manager

skills.expectation: Take buyers around the project and sample flat and explain layouts, amenities and payment plans
Follow up walk-ins and digital enquiries quickly and push them to site visits and revisits
Prepare cost sheets and booking forms and see the buyer through allotment and the agreement for sale
Connect buyers with tie-up banks and track their home loan sanction
Know the RERA registration details of the project and keep sales promises within RERA rules
Log every enquiry, site visit and follow-up in the CRM
Close bookings against monthly and quarterly unit targets
Negotiate price, floor choice and payment terms within approved limits
Present the project clearly to families, often in more than one language
Work with channel partners (brokers) who bring buyers to the site
Meet prospects at offices and homes and run outdoor activations
Compare nearby competing projects on price and amenities
Keep a daily sales and follow-up tracker in Excel
